packages.name: Technical SEO Starter
packages.scope: One website; up to 5 publicly accessible URLs; basic access, metadata, internal-link and indexing-signal review.
packages.output: Prioritized findings and an action checklist. Implementation is quoted separately.

packages.name: Keyword Research Starter
packages.scope: One topic, one language, one target market; 25 keyword ideas grouped by intent and mapped to up to 5 existing or proposed pages.
packages.output: Keyword / topic map with intent notes and page recommendations. Live search-volume and difficulty metrics are not included.
features: Map topics to up to 5 pages

packages.name: On-page SEO Starter
packages.scope: One website; edit recommendations for up to 3 existing pages in one language.
packages.output: Proposed titles, meta descriptions, heading outlines and internal-link recommendations. Publishing and full article writing are quoted separately.

packages.name: SEO Starter Bundle
packages.scope: The Technical SEO Starter, Keyword Research Starter and On-page SEO Starter scopes for the same website, language and target market.
packages.output: 5-page audit, 25-keyword map and edit recommendations for 3 pages. The listed starter exclusions still apply.
features: On-page edit brief: up to 3 pages
